text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(Being busy is no excuse. This is simply a 
sign of my own negligence in failing to 
manage it all.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(...What an utter disgrace. At this rate, 
shining with the utmost radiance is out of 
the—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“—First, I need to review my diet. I must 
also rethink my skincare routine. And 
then...”

Daiichi Ruby was distressed by her skin 
breakout...
